transcript: Speaker 1 @0.0s [en]: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. This is the Q4 roadmap sync and we have a lot to cover, so let's get started.
Speaker 2 @10.7s [en]: Sure. Before we start, I want to mention that the Netlify deploys have been failing intermittently since Monday.
Speaker 2 @12.5s [en]: I saw that too. It looks like the build runs out of memory when it bundles the reports module.
Speaker 1 @18.2s [en]: Okay, let's put that on the list. First, where are we with the Visma integration?
Speaker 3 @20.7s [ar]: هذا الشيء شغالين عليه بس كاستمرز اند البينك ساورز ستيل مسينغ.
Speaker 3 @27.5s [ar]: بالصراحة الجزء الأصعب هو البينك لان عندهم ليمتس على عدد الطلبات.
Speaker 2 @34.9s [en]: How many requests per minute do they allow?
Speaker 3 @36.9s [en]: 160 per minute. So we need a Q and a rate limiter.
Speaker 2 @42.2s [en]: Can we use the same queue we built for the Supabase webhooks?
Speaker 2 @46.5s [en]: Probably, yes. It already handles retries and backoff, so it should be a small change.
Speaker 1 @51.5s [en]: Great. Let's decide that the Visma sync reuses the existing webhook queue.
Speaker 3 @53.5s [ar]: تمام. أنا بخلص السنك للعملاء ودفعات قبل نهاية الأسبوع الجاي.
Speaker 1 @60.0s [en]: Next topic is Milkman. Leila, you spoke with them yesterday?
Speaker 1 @90.0s [en]: Right?
Speaker 2 @91.7s [en]: Leila couldn't join today. But she sent me notes. Milkman wants a pilot for three of their warehouses.
Speaker 1 @96.1s [en]: Do they want the pilot before or after the new year?
Speaker 2 @98.1s [en]: Before the new year if possible. They also asked about pricing for more than 50 users.
Speaker 3 @100.9s [ar]: تمام. أنا بخلص السنك للعملاء ودفعات قبل نهاية الأسبوع الجاي.
Speaker 1 @107.9s [en]: Next topic is Milkman. Leila, you spoke with them yesterday?
Speaker 2 @110.6s [en]: Sorry about that. I had to take a quick call. Where were we?
Speaker 1 @115.1s [en]: Right. Payments.
Speaker 2 @116.0s [en]: We compared providers last week. Stripe has better documentation and supports the local cards we need.
Speaker 3 @120.2s [ar]: بس الرسومي بتاعتها على الشوا لازم ناخذها بعين الاعتبار.
Speaker 2 @126.9s [en]: True, but the integration time is much shorter, and that matters more for Q4.
Speaker 1 @131.2s [en]: Okay, then the decision is to go with Stripe for payments this quarter.
Speaker 1 @134.9s [en]: Now back to the Netli
Speaker 2 @180.0s [en]: Mark, what do you need to fix the build?
Speaker 1 @184.5s [en]: I want to split the reports bundle and raise the memory limit on the staging site first.
Speaker 2 @187.0s [en]: Can you test it on staging before we touch production?
Speaker 1 @188.7s [en]: Yes, I will deploy the fix to the Netlify staging site tomorrow and report back.
Speaker 3 @191.7s [ar]: وإذا نجحت نقدر ننزله على برودكشن يوم الأحد.
Speaker 1 @196.7s [en]: Last thing, the release freeze.
Speaker 1 @198.7s [en]: I propose we freeze new features on Friday the 20th.
Speaker 2 @201.5s [en]: That works for me, as long as bug fixes can still go out.
Speaker 1 @204.0s [en]: Yes, bug fixes are fine.
Speaker 1 @205.5s [en]: So we freeze features on Friday the 20th.
Speaker 3 @207.5s [ar]: تمام، متفقين.
Speaker 3 @209.0s [ar]: شكراً للجميع.
Speaker 1 @210.5s [en]: Thanks everyone.
Speaker 1 @211.7s [en]: See you next week.

direct.summary: ناقش الاجتماع خارطة طريق الربع الرابع، بدءًا بمشكلة فشل نشر Netlify بسبب نفاد الذاكرة. تم الاتفاق على إعادة استخدام قائمة انتظار الويب هوك الحالية لتكامل Visma. كما تم التطرق إلى مشروع Milkman، حيث يرغبون في تجربة قبل نهاية العام. تقرر استخدام Stripe للمدفوعات في هذا الربع نظرًا لسرعة التكامل. سيقوم S1 بنشر إصلاح لمشكلة Netlify على بيئة الاختبار غدًا، مع إمكانية النشر للإنتاج يوم الأحد. أخيرًا، تم الاتفاق على تجميد الميزات الجديدة في 20 أكتوبر، مع السماح بإصلاحات الأخطاء.
